name: ARMADA
recent: Bumi Armada 于2026年10月完成资本削减，并与 Wison New Energies 及 FPSO Ventures 签署战略合作协议，推动 FLNG 租赁与运营方案。公司2026年第二季度净利环比增长76.9%至7097万令吉，但营收同比下滑17.7%。
notable: 公司与 Wison New Energies 及 FPSO Ventures 签署战略合作协议，推进 FLNG 租赁与运营方案。
公司于2026年亚洲油气大奖中获得两项荣誉。
risks: 2026年第二季度营收同比下滑17.7%，净利同比下滑11.3%。
媒体报导行业可能出现大型 FPSO 合并。
earnings: 2026年第二季度营收为3.3518亿令吉，环比增长9.3%，同比下滑17.7%；净利为7097万令吉，环比增长76.9%，同比下滑11.3%；净利率为21.2%，高于上一季度的13.1%。

recent_en: Bumi Armada completed a capital reduction in October 2026 and signed a strategic cooperation agreement with Wison New Energies and FPSO Ventures to advance FLNG lease-and-operate solutions. Net profit for Q2 2026 rose 76.9% QoQ to MYR 70.97 million, while revenue fell 17.7% YoY.
notable_en: The company signed a strategic cooperation agreement with Wison New Energies and FPSO Ventures to advance FLNG lease-and-operate solutions.
The company completed a capital reduction.
The company won two accolades at the Asian Oil & Gas Awards 2026.
risks_en: Q2 2026 revenue fell 17.7% YoY and net profit fell 11.3% YoY.
Media reported a potential mega FPSO merger in the industry.
earnings_en: Q2 2026 revenue was MYR 335.18 million, up 9.3% QoQ but down 17.7% YoY; net profit was MYR 70.97 million, up 76.9% QoQ but down 11.3% YoY; net margin was 21.2%, higher than 13.1% in the previous quarter.
